nom: NYX Professional Makeup The Face Unglue Makeup Remover Cleansing Balm

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation or stinging, including around the eyes, but two reviewers with sensitive or acne-prone skin say the balm broke them out or could trigger a breakout given how moisturizing it is.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin report the balm did not cause breakouts for them, though one notes the directions should specify that oily and acne-prone skin needs to emulsify it with water and follow with a cleanser.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry, sensitive skin reports it did not irritate her skin while removing eye makeup.
segments.mature: One reviewer with mature skin values the balm's moisturizing effect while it removes her makeup.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with acne-prone or oily skin, report the balm did not cause new breakouts, but two reviewers describe it breaking them out, one noting sensitive or acne-prone skin could react to how moisturizing it is.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report their skin feels soft, hydrated and not stripped or tight after use, including on dry winter skin.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers say the balm does not leave a greasy or oily film once rinsed, but several note it can feel slightly oily right after application or leave a residue that needs a follow-up cleanser to fully clear.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports no irritation or extra redness compared with other cleansers she has used.

aspects.libelle: Struggles to fully remove waterproof mascara or eyeliner
Melts on contact into a silky oil
Noticeable glue-like or chemical scent for some
No scoop included for the balm
A little product goes a long way
Strong value compared to higher-end balms
Can blur vision briefly for contact-lens wearers

extraits.titre: Did not live up to the hype
extraits.texte: I wanted to like this for the price point, however sadly I did not. The first thing that hit me was the strong chemical smell. Personally, I prefer fragrance free or maybe a faint citrus sell. This immediately smelled strong in chemicals. Secondly, it was a very gritty texture compared to others I have tried (ELF, Farmacy, etc) and lastly, this did not do a good job of taking off my eye makeup. I would apply to my eyes before other areas and let it have time to melt and I still ended up having to use another product to remove my eye makeup. If the price point hits for you, I would suggest ELF in lieu of this.

extraits.titre: Decent cleansing, not all makeup was removed
extraits.texte: I received this product to try out. I liked this balm for breaking up my makeup, but it wasn't able to get it ALL off. I found parts of my eyeliner were still on after both washing with water and using a damp cloth to rub it off. It did feel nice and melted easily onto my skin, but it was thick enough to blur my vision for a little while with my contacts on. I probably wouldn't reach for it as my routine makeup remover, but maybe occasionally for heavy foundation use.

extraits.titre: Removes makeup well, but careful on sensitive skin
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cleansing balm does the job of getting stubborn makeup off. But it did break me out after using. I have continued to use for removing waterproof mascara and it's great. It does not sting or irritate my eyes.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cleansing is pretty good! It's breaks down makeup, emulsifies into a milky texture, and rinses pretty well. I follow up w/ double cleansing and I get a proper clean. I feel like the packaging could be bigger and maybe I was just sent the smaller size. I also wish the directions were better because for some people, this could be their first cleansing balm at this price point, and for acne prone-oily skin, cleansing balms need to be emulsified with water and followed with a cleanser. The directions should say that.

extraits.titre: great makeup remover, especially for waterproof makeup
extraits.texte: this lightweight formula is actually very effective and a little product goes a long way. this makeup remover is great for long, lasting waterproof makeup, specifically eye makeup. also, it does not leave a greasy film after application or rinsing, but I will say if you have sensitive skin or acne prone skin because of how moisturizing it is, it could trigger a breakout. aside from this, it is a great product.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] i liked this cleansing balm. i felt like it removed all my makeup well, including my mascara. the consistency is thick, yet smooth, and feels nice to massage into the skin. i have acne prone, oily skin and it did not break me out. i would repurchase this product!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a very affordable cleansing balm! It works well, even on eye makeup, without irritating my dry, sensitive skin. I didn't notice any scent when using this. And the packaging is pretty standard - plastic and not too big.
